```{r}
install.packages("pdftools")
library(pdftools)

```
```{r}

# Define the path to the folder containing the PDFs
pdf_folder <- "permits_pdf"

# List all PDF files in the folder
pdf_files <- list.files(pdf_folder, pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)

# Define the keywords you're searching for
keywords <- c("LNG", "methane", "natural gas", "liqufied natural gas", "liquified methane", "liquified methane gas", "UN 1972", "1972")

# Create a data frame to store results
results <- data.frame(
  file = character(),
  keyword_found = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop through each PDF file
for (pdf_path in pdf_files) {
  # Try to extract text from the PDF
  text <- tryCatch(
    pdf_text(pdf_path),
    error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Error reading %s: %s", pdf_path, e$message))
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  
  # Skip this file if we couldn’t extract text
  if (is.null(text)) next
  
  # Combine all pages into one string
  full_text <- paste(text, collapse = " ")
  
  # Search for each keyword
  for (word in keywords) {
    if (grepl(word, full_text, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      # Add to results if keyword is found
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        file = basename(pdf_path),
        keyword_found = word,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Show the first few results
head(results)

# Optionally write to CSV
 write.csv(results, "permit_keyword_hits.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
